messages:
sam: Heads-up — product wants per-project quotas tied to service accounts for the new routing/quotas UX. Need to decide auth model + migration path.
tara: Do we mean quota per project or per token? PM is leaning project-level so billing is clear.
lee: Prefer service-account-backed quota buckets. SA owns the bucket, tokens minted from SA inherit the bucket. That lets teams rotate tokens without remapping quotas.
maria: Customer ask: they want an org-level shared pool for bursts. We should support org->project->sa fallback for quota resolution.
alex: Implementation idea: keep long-lived SA key (private key stored in KMS) and provide a token-exchange endpoint to mint short-lived scoped tokens. Example exchange call:
```
POST /v1/token/exchange
{
  "grant_type": "sa_jwt",
  "jwt": "<signed-jwt-from-sa>",
  "scope": ["inference:generate"],
  "aud": "redwood"
}
```
response: { "access_token": "...", "expires_in": 3600, "sa_id": "sa_123" }

sre-jen: Telemetry needs the token metadata (sa_id, project_id, org_id) on every request so we can attribute cost/latency. Also prefer token hash in logs instead of raw token.
sam: Console UX: when creating SA, show quota slider + "inherit from org" checkbox and a toggle to issue short-lived tokens only. Also surface rotation button and last-used time :gear:
tara: Security note: require HSM/KMS-backed keys for org-level SAs or at least mandatory rotation and audit logs for those. Need to define key policy.
maria: Migration plan: accept existing API keys as legacy SAs for 90 days, auto-expire unless user converts to SA+exchange flow. We should surface conversion tool in console.
alex: API contract proposal (draft):
```
POST /v1/token/exchange
body: { grant_type: "sa_jwt", jwt: "...", scope: ["..."] }
200: { access_token, token_type: "Bearer", expires_in, sa_id, project_id }
```
Also add /v1/service-accounts endpoints for CRUD and quota bindings.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature/token-exchange branch deployed to staging :rocket:
sre-jen: Decision summary: quotas resolved by precedence SA > project > org. We'll record the resolved bucket id in traces. I'll author the doc and DB migration plan.
sam: Action items: @lee take DB migration, @alex implement token endpoint + tests, @tara write security requirements, @maria own migration UX. I'll mock the console screens. Thanks everyone!
